deploybot: Scheduling Dedicated rollout for CinderPath. Start window: 2026-01-15 01:30 UTC. Canary ramp: 7% -> 22% -> 100% with 25m observation windows. Model pinned: `rwinf-4.1.1-int8`. Runtime image: `redwood/runtime:2025-12-20-d5`. KMS key: `projects/cinderpath/keys/cp-key-2`. Release notes: https://rdw.co/releases/4.1.1. Rollback triggers: 5xx > 0.6% (5m) OR p95 > 550ms (5m). Ticket: RD-4227.
maria: Small request: start canary at 7% -> can we make the second step 28% instead of 22%? ops prefers even spread to shorten total window.
kevin: 28% is fine but expect higher KV-cache warming; suggest `--canary-warmup=60s`.
ops_lead: Also pin network agent to `net-agent:1.8.0` and ensure `redwood/runtime:2025-11-10-c1` is available for rollback.
sre_oncall: Add automated short-circuit: if p95 rises > 200ms above baseline for 3m, autoscale to canary-burst and pause shift. Page if p95 > 700ms for 2m or 5xx > 1% for 2m.
security: cp-key-2 rotation is scheduled 2026-01-15 03:00 UTC; overlaps post-rollout window. @tara can customer defer +8h?
tara: Confirmed customer can move rotation to 2026-01-15 11:00 UTC. They'll expect an audit note.
maria: I'll update runbook and add rotation exception.
deploybot: Plan updated: 7% -> 28% -> 100%. Example start cmd:
```
rdw-deploy start --customer cinderpath --model rwinf-4.1.1-int8 --canary 7 --steps 28,100 --window 25m --runtime redwood/runtime:2025-12-20-d5 --warmup 60s
```
logs: https://rdw.co/logs/cinderpath/1769995555
kevin: Runbook rollback snippets:
```
rdw-deploy rollback --customer cinderpath --to rwinf-4.1.0
rdw-check state --customer cinderpath --expect model=rwinf-4.1.0 --slices=all
rdw-cache flush --customer cinderpath --kv-prefix="rwinf-4.1.1"
```
ops_lead: Health gate: require <0.25% 5xx for 12m before final commit.
sre_oncall: Oncall will monitor; +30m pre-window standby. Page thresholds set.
security: Exception logged and audit note will be attached to RD-4227.
maria: All set. Any objections to start at 01:30 UTC?
kevin: No objections.
ops_lead: Ops ready.
sre_oncall: Ready.
tara: Customer expects status pings at each boundary. I'll post updates.
